name: diagonal-run
description: Hold RIGHT+UP for 30 ticks. Exercises vector-length friction: both axes saturate independently but only one friction quantum is removed from the combined length, so the diagonal covers ~sqrt(2)x the ground of an axis-aligned run. A per-axis damping port diverges here on tick 1. UP rather than DOWN deliberately — DOWN from the y=128 spawn runs into the y=157 world clamp within 30 ticks, which would silently turn this into a second clamp fixture; UP also exercises the negative-axis guard (v.y > -moveSpeed).
